citations.assessment: Yeimar bar Shelemya asks Abaye about brothers who each mind the other’s food.
Yeimar bar Shelemya transmits Abaye about deliberately stumbling while carrying the stone.
Yeimar bar Shelemya transmits Abaye about stirring in a crosswise motion.
Yeimar bar Shelemya transmits Abaye’s conditions regarding the two sides of a river.
Yeimar bar Shelemiah transmits Abaye’s explanation of Rabbi Yoshiyah.
The passage alternates Yeimar bar Shelemya and Yeimar bar Shizvi as Mar Zutra’s interlocutor.
Yeimar bar Shelemya sends Rav Pappa a question about Rabbi Shimon Shezuri’s ruling.
Yeimar bar Shelemya objects to Rava regarding the enforcement of terms made by townspeople.
